"import cadquery as cq

# Establish the XZ plane: local (u, v) maps to global (u, 0, v)
P = cq.Plane.named("XZ")

# Line 1: from (32, 0) to (2, -17)
p_a = P.toWorldCoords((32, 0))
p_b = P.toWorldCoords((2, -17))

# Line 2: from (2, -17) to (-32, 0)
p_c = P.toWorldCoords((-32, 0))

# Spline fit points through (-32,0), (-19,24), (-4,31), (12,26), (24,12), (32,0)
spline_pts = [(-32, 0), (-19, 24), (-4, 31), (12, 26), (24, 12), (32, 0)]
spline_world = [P.toWorldCoords(pt) for pt in spline_pts]

# Build the 3 curve entities
edge1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(p_a, p_b)      # Line (32,0) -> (2,-17)
edge2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(p_b, p_c)      # Line (2,-17) -> (-32,0)
edge3 = cq.Edge.makeSpline(spline_world)  # Smooth spline (-32,0) -> ... -> (32,0)

edges = [edge1, edge2, edge3]

# Export exactly 3 edges as a single compound to sketch.step
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
